messages.subject: Compare densities between different methods
parts:
Good evening,

I ask you experts for a suggestion. How do you recommend comparing the density obtained in the same area between two different methods? Between DS and more. 

Or simply being the same unit (individuals/hectare) there is no need to do anything else?

I apologize for the trivial question.

Niccolò

Niccolò

Any density estimate has an associated measure of uncertainty, probably a standard error. Given the pair of estimates and their standard errors, a statistical test can be conducted. In Buckland et al. (2001) [Sect. 3.6.5] methods are described to produce tests of significance based on t-test methods. A portion of that text is provided below
